levels.surface: محمد بن الحسن بن أحمد بن الوليد
أحمد بن محمد بن يحيى العطار

notes: «حدثنا أبي» opens with the compiler's own father, named only by relation (rule 7).
«قالوا» joins three shaykhs of the compiler in one level; «رضي الله عنهم» is an honorific and left out.
The Imam is written after «عن» inside the chain (ruling 2): a narrator; the matn that follows is his report of the Companions' conduct.
